title: lespedeza frutescens
intro: Lespedeza frutescens, commonly known as Chinese bush clover or Chinese shrub clover, is a perennial legume plant native to China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving coughs, and alleviating symptoms of bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Lespedeza frutescens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Lespedeza frutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
